implementation.storage: Fixed-size trivially copyable public counters/masks/context; no strings, pointer views or per-event allocation. Per-converter events reset each decode; reader aggregation is monotonic across version/codepage changes.
implementation.counters: Completed semantic decode calls, non-ASCII input calls, legacy-byte-converter calls (including ASCII), actual opt-in recovery calls, issue-bearing calls, and overlapping per-issue call counters. Saturating uint64 with explicit flag; not character/entity/unique-record coverage.
implementation.source: Piggyback converter branches for zero-table deletion, unmatched DBCS replacement, malformed UTF8/scalars/UTF16 and unresolved escape-looking tokens. Independent input/decode events, not inference from result string length or '?' / U+FFFD.
implementation.selection: Only non-ASCII bytes actually using a legacy decoder receive page-selection issues. Modern UTF8/inert metadata and actual recovery path do not use an ignored legacy mapping. Original category survives existing reapply policy; mismatched normalized/reapplied decoder gets separate issue.
implementation.context: First observed issue: group code when known, one-based physical record and bytes consumed through its value/delimiter when physical. Binary end offset includes sentinel. End is not offending code-unit/start position. Assembled/deferred values do not fabricate record/end offsets; deferred order need not be physical source order.
implementation.exclusions: $ACADVER/$DWGCODEPAGE declaration metadata, structural markers/controls, handles, binary payloads and raw carrier access are not semantic observations. Raw bytes and old decoding behavior remain unchanged.
implementation.lifecycle: Live read getter sees active reader; normal completion and noexcept scope unwind copy fixed observations before reader disposal. Admitted file read clears even on early argument/open failure. readAscii(nullptr), rejected nesting and writes preserve last-read snapshot. Ordinary next read resets. Prefix observations survive later failure and callback exceptions, including file stream destruction.
implementation.utf8_shared_check: Existing scalar/one-byte-invalid-consumption rules factored into an allocation-free helper, reused by encode decodeNum and typed-XDATA scalar preflight; no mapping or fallback output changes.
implementation.compatibility: No new pure callbacks or external dependencies/private includes in installed API. Public facade/base layouts change; consumers rebuild. No binary ABI, concurrency, full-memory, full-parser safety or charset support certificate.
